name: Tailgate Alert — Door + Motion Within 8 Seconds
description: Fires only when both a door I/O input AND motion detection occur within 8 seconds of each other — a compound trigger pattern. A single event alone (door with no motion, or background motion with no door) does not fire the rule. Demonstrates trigger_logic AND with trigger_window.
